Posted 27 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

No starting section. The strategy starts Watch Your Step (posted 'Watch your step/This place is rough') and uses Heading For The Medical Frigate to start Wise Advice/There Is No Try, Battle Plan and Draw Their Fire; three Effects start and none is singled out, so no starting Effect is set. All are in the list and count.
